title: Review of c07's kstrail RD-twin finding: replicated on seeds 21-22; kstrail swims 6-20 BL, the matched twin <= 1 BL, the 5x-slower twin <= 2.8 BL, unchanged at dt/2
summary: Fresh labkit runs on seeds 21 and 22 (192^2, T=600). kstrail from noise: 24 and 21 moving tracks, top-10 tracks 6.6-15.5 and 5.9-19.8 body lengths, max speed 0.58 and 0.48 (sheet: isolated crescents swimming through open space). Matched twin (kh 0.05, planted disks): 1 and 0 moving tracks, max 1.0 and 0.8 BL; round spots self-replicate (16 and 14 persistent splits, gen 4) and sit. 5x-slower twin (kh 0.01): crescents with trails, 12 and 10 moving tracks but max 2.8 and 2.0 BL, speed <= 0.28, replicating and jamming (gen 3). The slow twin at dt/2 (world copy with dt=0.025 in META and P) gives the same: max 2.8 and 2.0 BL, speed 0.21 and 0.28. The finding replicates and its 'no dt/2 check' limit is now closed for the slow twin.

observations.M: kstrail/seed21/FACTS.md: 24 moving tracks, max 15.5 BL, speed 0.58 (sheet t=261-600, crescents crossing open space); twin_kh05/seed21: max 1.0 BL; twin_kh01/seed21 and seed22: max 2.8 and 2.0 BL; twin_kh01_dt2: 2.8 and 2.0 BL

controls_run.M: twin_kh05/ (matched twin, seeds 21-22), twin_kh01/ (5x slower inhibitor), twin_kh01_dt2/ (same at dt/2)

verdicts.limitation: Same limits as the finding: one kinetic family, and the twin is planted (its uniform state decays) while kstrail forms from noise. Twin bodies are ~2x larger, which lowers their body-length counts, but raw speeds agree (twin <= 0.28 vs kstrail 0.48-0.58). The slow twin's crescents do crawl; what it lacks is sustained free swimming, because its bodies replicate and jam. labkit's --dt flag only relabels time, so a real dt/2 check needs a world copy (world_slow5_dt2.py here).
